name: rnperf-monorepo
description: React Native performance monitor for macOS, with an MCP bridge for coding agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rnperf/protocol && npm run build -w @rnperf/daemon && npm run build -w @rnperf/sdk && npm run build -w @rnperf/mcp-server
scripts.daemon: npm run build -w @rnperf/protocol && npm run build -w @rnperf/daemon && node packages/daemon/dist/cli.js daemon
